rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope and sign convention; project retained. The difference is line 5, the long-term capital loss carryover, which the project refuses (`sd.carryover`, spec 2.2) and carries as zero; the second transcription reads the parentheses on the worksheet's line 5 (i1040sd p. 11, 28% Rate Gain Worksheet) as a positive amount to be subtracted. Within scope the two agree. When carryovers come into scope, line 5 must be subtracted or held negative, as recorded for Schedule D lines 7 and 15.
